content.title: Where to watch Martinez vs Aleem? - World Boxing Council
content.text: Lester Martínez will fight for the interim super middleweight title against Immanuwel Aleem. Lester Martinez made his professional debut on March 6, 2019, facing former world champion Ricardo Mayorga. The Guatemalan won the fight by TKO in the second round. After five fights, Martinez earned his first title opportunity. He fought for the WBC Latino super middleweight title against Uriel Gonzalez, knocking him out in the first round. After continuing to build his record with multiple victories, he once again fought for the WBC Latino super middleweight title. In 2024, he faced Rubén Angulo and won by KO in the second round. Last year, he fought Christian Mbilli for the WBC interim super middleweight title. The bout ended in a draw, with Mbilli retaining the belt. That fight was named Fight of the Year. Martinez remains undefeated with a record of 19 wins, 16 of them by knockout. Immanuwel Aleem made his professional debut on June 26, 2012, facing Jess Noriega, whom he defeated by TKO in the first round. His first WBC title came in 2017. On January 14, he defeated Ievgen Khytrov by TKO to win the WBC Silver middleweight title. Later, in 2024, he captured the WBC FECARBOX super middleweight title by defeating Malcolm Jones. His most recent title, and last fight, came in mid-2025, when he won the WBC FECARBOX light heavyweight title. Aleem holds a professional record of 22-3-3, with 14 knockouts. When and where is the fight? The fight will take place on Saturday, March 21, at the National Orange Show Event Center in San Bernardino, California, United States. Where to watch the fight? The fight will be broadcast on ProBox TV.
